title: Restructure bundled hlx-cli skill: progressive disclosure + CI sync
description: Tour of the 8 files created/modified to restructure the bundled hlx-cli skill with progressive disclosure, full CLI surface coverage, and CI enforcement.

steps.title: Trigger-heavy YAML description
steps.description: The frontmatter description (481 chars, <=1024 limit) front-loads triggers for both CLI-ops (HELIX_API_KEY, inspect, tickets) and ticket-writing (writing tickets, ticket prompting, install recovery). This helps agents activate the skill from diverse requests.

steps.title: Progressive disclosure: Workflow section
steps.description: The body starts with Workflow (smallest command first), then Guardrails, then Commands at a glance. This progressive-disclosure pattern lets agents find high-frequency commands fast without reading the full surface.

steps.title: Ticket work gotchas
steps.description: Documents the --description file-path gotcha (CLI errors when value resolves to a readable file), 10k-char cap, dependency flags, --dry-run, update-description, and --mode RESEARCH guidance.

steps.title: Full tickets list coverage
steps.description: Previously missing flags (--search, --user, --status, --status-not-in, --archived, --sprint, --json) are now documented with descriptions. Each subcommand has its own heading, usage line, and flag table.

steps.title: tickets create with full enum coverage
steps.description: Documents --mode enum values (AUTO, BUILD, FIX, RESEARCH, EXECUTE) and the --description vs --description-file distinction. All previously-missing flags are now present.

steps.title: Library comments post with rating values
steps.description: Documents --section, --rating, --reply-to flags and all rating enum values: thumbs-up (alias up), thumbs-down (alias down), love.

steps.title: Ticket authoring guide
steps.description: 7-section guide using hard-constraint language (must, must not, do not). Contains the required ticket structure, 5 common failure modes with examples, deployment checklist, and draft review checklist.

steps.title: GitHub-release-asset recovery guide
steps.description: Documents the post-PR-86 install/update flow sourced from src/update/**. Covers hlx update mechanism, fresh install, broken-install recovery, and auto-update. No npm install/uninstall/link recommendations.

steps.title: Dated migration note
steps.description: Changelog entry for 2026-05-21 marking the PR #86 migration from npm to GitHub release assets.

steps.title: Recursive token collection
steps.description: The collectTokens function recursively walks --help output starting from the top level. At each level it extracts subcommand names, long-form flags, and enum values, then recurses into discovered subcommands.

steps.title: Subcommand blocklist and regex filter
steps.description: A blocklist and regex filter (/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/) prevent false positives from non-command words like 'Usage:' and 'workbench' that appear in help text.

steps.title: Coverage check with clear error output
steps.description: Missing tokens are collected and printed to stderr with type labels ([subcommand], [flag], [enum]). Exit 0 = all covered, exit 1 = missing tokens, exit 2 = script error.

steps.title: CI workflow triggers
steps.description: Runs on pull_request (all branches) and push to main. Uses Node 22 and npm ci (which triggers tsc build via prepare script), then runs the parser script.

steps.title: Skill-update checkbox
steps.description: Contributor reminder to update SKILL.md or commands.md when changing user-visible CLI behavior.
